title: Under the Square

victory.note: The Germans win if they end the game in control of 1 hex of the largest stone building in columns U to EE. Otherwise the Russians win.

situation: The Germans hold the west end of a square, and the Russians hold the east end. The Germans must take the east end, and the Russians must hold it. Below the square, a stack with a leader can go through the sewers from one entrance to the next, and the enemy cannot fire on it there. The Germans attack with 8 squads under 2 leaders and 4 support weapons. The Russians hold with 5 squads under 2 leaders. The Germans win if they end the game in control of 1 hex of the largest stone building in columns U to EE. Otherwise the Russians win. The Germans also hold the largest stone building in columns C to I. It does not count for the victory. A die roll decides which side moves first. 6 turns.
notes: A project scenario of the library, slot L03 (owner directive, 2026-10-16), not a printed scenario. `sl-cli library` made it from draw seed 8 and board seed 10. The rule level is 27. The defending force is 355 points and the attacking force is 600 points on the scale of slcampaign.points, a share of 5 to 3. No part of it is card text (SR-07). Balance (gate item 4, 2026-10-17): v7 against v7 gave the German side 802 of 1,600 games (50.1 percent), artifact runs/20261017T033921Z-library-l03-s1-10. Gate item 3: v3, v6, and v7 played it to the end on the two sides. The card names each building by its rank and its band of columns, and it says what the sewers do (owner, 2026-10-17).
